careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.description: Turns business data into reports, dashboards and answers that help teams decide what to do.
involves: Clean and combine data from different sources
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree with strong numbers work (commerce, economics, statistics, engineering, science). A portfolio of analyses matters more than the degree.
careers.opportunities: Entry-level friendly. Leads to senior analyst, analytics manager, data scientist or product analyst roles.
projects: Analyse a public dataset (e.g. city bike trips) and publish a one-page dashboard
Write SQL queries that answer five business questions about a sample sales database

careers.title: Data Engineer
careers.description: Builds the pipelines and storage that move data reliably from where it is created to where it is used.
involves: Keep data fast, correct and secure
careers.education: Bachelor's in computer science, IT or engineering, or equivalent experience.
careers.opportunities: High demand. Leads to senior/lead data engineer, data architect or platform roles.
projects: Build a daily pipeline that downloads a public dataset, cleans it and loads it into a database
Set up a small warehouse and a scheduled job with Airflow

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Uses statistics and machine learning to find patterns and build models that predict or explain things.
involves: Communicate what the model can and can't do
careers.education: Bachelor's in a quantitative field; many roles prefer a master's. Strong projects can substitute.
careers.opportunities: Leads to senior/lead data scientist, ML engineer or research roles.
projects: Predict house prices with a regression model and explain the main drivers
Build a churn model and present it as a short report

careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds and maintains software applications and services.
careers.education: Bachelor's in computer science or related, or a strong project portfolio.
careers.opportunities: Very broad market. Leads to senior engineer, tech lead or architect roles.
projects: Build and deploy a small full-stack app with login
Contribute a fix to an open-source project

careers.title: Business Analyst
careers.description: Works between business teams and technology to define problems, gather requirements and measure results.
involves: Track results with simple data analysis
careers.education: Bachelor's in business, commerce, engineering or similar. Certifications like ECBA help but are optional.
careers.opportunities: Leads to product manager, consultant or operations lead roles.
projects: Map an everyday process (e.g. college admissions) and propose three improvements
Build a requirements document and a simple KPI dashboard for a mock app

careers.title: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.description: Takes machine learning models from notebooks into reliable products that real users depend on.
involves: Work with data scientists and software engineers
careers.education: Bachelor's or master's in computer science or a related field.
careers.opportunities: Fast-growing. Leads to senior ML engineer, MLOps or AI engineering roles.
projects: Serve a trained model behind a small API and add basic monitoring
Build an image classifier and deploy it as a web demo

careers.title: Cloud Engineer
careers.description: Sets up and runs the cloud infrastructure that applications and data platforms live on.
involves: Keep systems available and costs under control
careers.education: Bachelor's in IT or computer science; cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) are valued.
careers.opportunities: Strong demand. Leads to cloud architect, DevOps or security roles.
projects: Deploy a web app on a cloud free tier using infrastructure as code
Set up monitoring and alerts for a small service

careers.title: DevOps Engineer
careers.description: Automates how software is built, tested and released, and keeps it running smoothly.
careers.education: Bachelor's in IT or computer science, or equivalent experience.
careers.opportunities: Leads to SRE, platform engineering or cloud architecture.
projects: Set up a CI pipeline that tests and deploys a small app
Containerise an app with Docker and run it on Kubernetes locally

careers.title: Analytics Engineer
careers.description: Sits between data engineering and analysis: turns raw tables into clean, tested models analysts can trust.
careers.education: Bachelor's in a technical or quantitative field.
careers.opportunities: Growing role. Leads to senior analytics engineer or data engineering.
projects: Model a raw e-commerce dataset into clean tables with tests
Document a small data model so a newcomer can use it

careers.title: BI Developer
careers.description: Builds the data models and dashboards that a company uses for everyday reporting.
careers.education: Bachelor's in IT, commerce or engineering. Tool certifications (Power BI, Tableau) help.
careers.opportunities: Leads to BI lead, analytics engineer or data engineer roles.
projects: Build a Power BI report with a proper star-schema model
Automate a weekly report from raw CSV files

careers.title: Data Architect
careers.description: Designs how an organisation's data is stored, connected and governed.
careers.education: Bachelor's in computer science or IT plus several years of data engineering experience.
careers.opportunities: Senior role, usually reached from data engineering.
projects: Design the data model for a small online store and justify the choices

careers.title: Product Analyst
careers.description: Studies how people use a product and helps teams decide what to build next.
careers.education: Bachelor's in any quantitative field.
careers.opportunities: Leads to senior product analyst, product manager or data scientist.
projects: Analyse a public app-usage dataset and find where users drop off
Design an A/B test plan for a feature idea

careers.title: School Teacher
careers.description: Teaches a subject to school students and helps each of them learn and grow.
careers.education: A bachelor's degree in the subject plus a teaching qualification (B.Ed in India); CTET/TET for many schools.
careers.opportunities: Steady demand in every city. Leads to head of department, curriculum design or school leadership.
projects: Teach a short online lesson to friends and collect feedback
Create a lesson plan with an activity and a quick quiz

careers.title: Instructional Designer
careers.description: Designs courses and training so people learn efficiently, often online.
involves: Work with experts to define what learners need
careers.education: Bachelor's in education, psychology, English or a related field; courses in instructional design help.
careers.opportunities: Companies, ed-tech and universities. Leads to learning experience design or L&D lead.
projects: Turn a textbook chapter into a 15-minute interactive module
Design a short course outline with learning goals and assessments

careers.title: Learning Experience Designer
careers.description: Designs engaging learning journeys using ideas from UX design and how people learn.
careers.education: Bachelor's in design, education or psychology; a portfolio is essential.
careers.opportunities: Ed-tech and corporate learning teams.
projects: Redesign an existing online course page and test it with three people

careers.title: Educational Technology Specialist
careers.description: Helps schools and teachers choose and use technology for teaching.
careers.education: Bachelor's in education or IT; experience in schools helps.
careers.opportunities: Schools, colleges and ed-tech companies.
projects: Set up a class on a free LMS with quizzes and a progress report

careers.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
careers.description: Plans and runs online campaigns across search, social media and email.
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree; Google and Meta marketing certificates are widely used.
careers.opportunities: Every industry hires. Leads to marketing manager or growth roles.
projects: Grow a small Instagram page for a cause and report what worked
Run a tiny ad campaign with a fixed budget and analyse the results

careers.title: SEO Specialist
careers.description: Helps websites appear higher in search results so more of the right people find them.
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree; hands-on results matter most.
careers.opportunities: Agencies, e-commerce and media. Leads to content or growth marketing lead.
projects: Audit a small website's SEO and fix the top five issues

careers.title: Brand Strategist
careers.description: Shapes how a company or product is seen: its story, voice and position against competitors.
careers.education: Bachelor's in marketing, mass communication, design or business.
careers.opportunities: Agencies and in-house brand teams.
projects: Write a brand positioning for a local business and test it with five customers

careers.title: Marketing Research Analyst
careers.description: Studies customers and markets to find out what people want and how products are doing.
careers.education: Bachelor's in marketing, statistics, economics or psychology.
careers.opportunities: Research firms, consumer brands. Leads to insights manager.
projects: Run a survey on students' food habits and present three insights with charts

careers.title: UX Researcher
careers.description: Finds out how people actually use products, so teams build things that work for them.
involves: Plan and run interviews and usability tests
Share findings with designers and engineers
careers.education: Bachelor's in psychology, design, HCI or a social science.
careers.opportunities: Tech and product companies. Leads to research lead.
projects: Test a popular app with five people and write up the three biggest problems

careers.title: Product Designer
careers.description: Designs how digital products look and work, from first sketch to the final screens.
careers.education: A design degree helps, but a strong portfolio matters most.
careers.opportunities: Startups to large tech. Leads to senior/lead designer.
projects: Redesign one screen of an app you use daily and explain each change

careers.title: Motion Graphics Designer
careers.description: Creates animated graphics for videos, ads, apps and social media.
careers.education: Diploma or degree in animation or design; portfolio is essential.
careers.opportunities: Agencies, media, gaming and ed-tech.
projects: Make a 20-second animated explainer about a topic you know

careers.title: Accessibility Designer
careers.description: Makes sure websites and apps can be used by everyone, including people with disabilities.
careers.education: Background in design or front-end development; accessibility certifications (CPACC) help.
careers.opportunities: Growing because of accessibility laws; product companies and government.
projects: Audit a public website for accessibility and fix five issues in a copy of it

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Watches for attacks on an organisation's systems and responds when something goes wrong.
careers.education: Bachelor's in IT or computer science; certifications like Security+ or CEH help.
careers.opportunities: Strong demand in every sector.
projects: Set up a home lab, generate test attacks and detect them in the logs

careers.title: AI Product Specialist
careers.description: Helps teams and customers use AI products well: explains, configures and improves them.
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree with technical understanding of AI.
careers.opportunities: New role at AI companies and teams adopting AI.
projects: Build and test a prompt-based helper for a real task, and document its limits

careers.title: Robotics Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds and programs robots and automated machines.
careers.education: Bachelor's in mechanical, electrical, electronics or mechatronics engineering.
careers.opportunities: Manufacturing, logistics, healthcare and research.
projects: Build a line-following robot with a microcontroller
Simulate a robot arm in ROS

careers.title: Cloud Security Engineer
careers.description: Protects applications and data that run in the cloud.
careers.education: Bachelor's in IT or computer science; cloud and security certifications are valued.
careers.opportunities: High demand as companies move to the cloud.
projects: Harden a small cloud setup: least-privilege access, logging and alerts

careers.title: Climate Data Analyst
careers.description: Analyses climate and environmental data to understand change and support decisions.
involves: Process weather, emissions or satellite data
Explain results to policy and business teams
careers.education: Bachelor's in environmental science, geography, statistics or engineering; master's often preferred.
careers.opportunities: Research bodies, NGOs, consultancies and climate-tech startups.
projects: Analyse 50 years of temperature data for your city and chart the trend

careers.title: GIS Specialist
careers.description: Builds and analyses maps and location data for planning, environment and logistics.
careers.education: Bachelor's in geography, geology, civil engineering or environmental science.
careers.opportunities: Government, urban planning, utilities, agriculture.
projects: Map green spaces in your area with free satellite data in QGIS

careers.title: Bioinformatics Analyst
careers.description: Analyses biological data such as DNA sequences to support medical and life-science research.
careers.education: Bachelor's or master's in biotechnology, bioinformatics or biology with programming.
careers.opportunities: Pharma, hospitals, research institutes.
projects: Analyse a public gene-expression dataset and find differences between two groups

careers.title: Sustainability Consultant
careers.description: Helps organisations measure and reduce their environmental impact.
careers.education: Bachelor's in environmental science, engineering or business; sustainability certifications help.
careers.opportunities: Consultancies and large companies with ESG goals.
projects: Estimate your college's yearly carbon footprint and suggest three reductions

careers.title: Supply Chain Analyst
careers.description: Keeps products flowing from suppliers to customers at the right cost and time.
involves: Find ways to cut cost and delays
careers.education: Bachelor's in engineering, commerce or supply chain management.
careers.opportunities: Manufacturing, retail, e-commerce, logistics.
projects: Build a demand forecast and reorder plan for a small shop's products

careers.title: Operations Research Analyst
careers.description: Uses maths and optimisation to help organisations make better decisions.
careers.education: Bachelor's or master's in operations research, maths, statistics or engineering.
careers.opportunities: Airlines, logistics, manufacturing, consulting.
projects: Optimise delivery routes for 10 addresses with a linear programming model

careers.title: Product Operations Specialist
careers.description: Keeps product teams running smoothly: tools, processes, data and launches.
careers.education: Any bachelor's degree; experience in operations or support helps.
careers.opportunities: Tech companies; leads to product manager or operations lead.
projects: Design a launch checklist and feedback tracker for a mock product

careers.title: Business Intelligence Consultant
careers.description: Helps client companies set up reporting and dashboards so they can run on data.
careers.education: Bachelor's in commerce, IT or engineering; BI tool certifications help.
careers.opportunities: Consultancies and IT services firms.
projects: Build a dashboard for a mock client from raw CSV files and present it in five minutes
